description: This file defines a plugin module for web channel runtime interactions, including functions for web authentication, messaging, media handling, and WebSocket management, with dynamic module loading and export management.

methods.name: resolveWebChannelPluginRecord
methods.description: Resolves the plugin record for the web channel runtime modules.

methods.name: resolveWebChannelRuntimeModulePath
methods.description: Resolves the module path for a given runtime API or light runtime API based on the plugin record.

methods.name: loadCurrentHeavyModuleSync
methods.description: Synchronously loads the current heavy runtime module for web channel.

methods.name: loadWebChannelLightModule
methods.description: Loads the web channel light runtime module, with caching.

methods.name: loadWebChannelHeavyModule
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the web channel heavy runtime module, with caching.

methods.name: getLightExport
methods.description: Retrieves a specific export from the light runtime module.

methods.name: getHeavyExport
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a specific export from the heavy runtime module.
